meta_description:
3,633 likes, 78 comments - aakritiranaofficial on September 20, 2026: "I can’t believe I actually got to live this dream!! 

Cars have meant more to me than just four wheels. They’ve been a little piece of the dream I’ve always chased and I finally got to drive a @lamborghini on a race track with nothing between me and the road.

Lamborghini Temerario—powered by performance, grounded by Bridgestone. I truly felt the @bridgestoneindia Difference.

📸 @shivamphotoworks 

#collab [ Aakriti rana, Lamborghini, buddh international circuit, race track, Lamborghini India, dream come true ]".
